# EmailCheckPro Email Bulk Avatar Check
> Official examples for the EmailCheckPro bulk product `email_avatar_batch`.

## Canonical resources
- [Product page](https://emailcheckpro.com/products/email_avatar_batch): Upload a whole file of addresses and download the avatars when the task finishes.
- [API documentation](https://emailcheckpro.com/api-docs): Canonical request, response, limit, and error contract.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/emailcheckpro/email-bulk-avatar-api): Official multi-language examples and OpenAPI contract.
- [Registration](https://emailcheckpro.com/register): Account registration and API-key access.
- [Pricing](https://emailcheckpro.com/pricing): Current product pricing.

## Product facts
- Brand: EmailCheckPro.
- Product code: email_avatar_batch.
- Mode: asynchronous bulk task.
- API base URL: https://emailcheckpro.com.
- Authentication: X-API-Key request header.
- Submit: POST /api/v1/bulk-tasks with product=email_avatar_batch and a file field.
- Poll: GET /api/v1/bulk-tasks/{id}; status is processing, success or failed.
- Poll interval: no more than once every 30 seconds.
- Task size: 1000 to 100000 entries, .txt or .csv, one email address per line.
- Input kind: email.
- Country: not applicable, the field is not sent.
- Result columns: email, activated, avatar.
- Billing: the file is reserved on submit; only checked entries are charged and the rest is returned. Failed tasks are refunded.
- Examples: Python, Node.js, Go, Java, C#, PHP, Shell.
